ऐश a. (शी f.) [ईश-अण्]
1
Belonging to Śiva; R. 2. 75.
--2
Supreme, regal.

ऐशान a. [ईशान-अण्] Belonging
to Śiva.
--नी
1 The northeastern
direction.
--2 N. of Durgā.

ऐषमस् ind. During this year,
in the present year.

ऐषमस्तन^1 --मस्त्य a. Belonging to
the present year.
